rules.description: Child must be at least 3 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be at least 3 years old to qualify for 30 hours free childcare

rules.description: Child must be under 5 years old (not yet in reception)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child is too old for this scheme. Children in reception class or older are not eligible.

rules.description: Parent (or both parents if couple) must be in paid work
rules.reason_if_failed: You (or both parents if in a couple) must be in paid work to qualify

rules.description: Each working parent must earn at least the equivalent of 16 hours at National Minimum Wage per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must earn at least the equivalent of 16 hours at National Minimum Wage per week

rules.description: Neither parent can earn more than £100,000 per year
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot earn more than £100,000 per year to qualify for 30 hours free childcare

rules.description: Partner (if applicable) cannot earn more than £100,000 per year
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner cannot earn more than £100,000 per year to qualify

rules.description: Parent must be a UK resident
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a UK resident to apply for this scheme

rules.description: Parent must not be receiving Income Support
rules.reason_if_failed: If you receive Income Support, you may not meet the minimum income requirement

edge_cases.description: Child is adopted and requires different documentation
edge_cases.action: Request adoption certificate instead of birth certificate. Standard eligibility applies.
Route to specialist team. Foster carers may have different eligibility criteria.

edge_cases.description: Parent has disability affecting ability to work
edge_cases.action: Parent may still qualify if receiving certain disability benefits. Route to specialist assessment.

edge_cases.description: One or both parents are self-employed
edge_cases.action: Income verification requires Self Assessment tax returns. May need manual review of accounts.

edge_cases.description: Parent is on statutory maternity, paternity, or adoption leave
edge_cases.action: Parent may still qualify if returning to work within expected timeframe. Verify employment status with employer.

edge_cases.description: Child has special educational needs or disabilities
edge_cases.action: Standard eligibility applies but may need additional information for childcare provider. Signpost to Early Years Special Educational Needs support.
